name: Disable Insecure HTTP Server
description: HTTP management interfaces transmit data in cleartext and must be disabled. Use HTTPS or SSH instead.

remediation.cisco:
configure terminal
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
end
write memory
remediation.juniper:
edit
delete system services web-management
commit
exit
remediation.palo_alto:
set deviceconfig system service disable-http yes
commit

name: Enable SSH / Disable Telnet
description: Telnet transmits credentials in cleartext. All management access must use SSH only.

remediation.cisco:
configure terminal
line vty 0 4
transport input ssh
login local
exit
crypto key generate rsa modulus 2048
end
write memory
remediation.juniper:
set system services ssh
delete system services telnet
commit
remediation.palo_alto:
set deviceconfig system service disable-telnet yes
commit

name: Enable NTP Time Synchronization
description: Accurate system time is critical for log correlation, certificate validation, and forensic investigation.

remediation.cisco:
configure terminal
ntp server 0.pool.ntp.org
ntp server 1.pool.ntp.org
end
write memory
remediation.juniper:
set system ntp server 0.pool.ntp.org
set system ntp server 1.pool.ntp.org
commit
remediation.palo_alto:
set deviceconfig system ntp-servers primary-ntp-server ntp-server-address 0.pool.ntp.org
commit

name: Enable Logging / Syslog
description: All network devices must forward logs to a central syslog server for SIEM integration and audit trails.

remediation.cisco:
configure terminal
logging on
logging host 10.0.0.100
logging trap informational
end
write memory
remediation.juniper:
set system syslog host 10.0.0.100 any info
commit
remediation.palo_alto:
set deviceconfig system syslog syslog-profile siem-server server 10.0.0.100
commit

name: Disable SNMP v1/v2 (Use SNMPv3)
description: SNMPv1 and v2 use community strings instead of authentication. SNMPv3 with auth/priv must be used.

remediation.cisco:
configure terminal
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
snmp-server group SNMPV3GROUP v3 priv
end
write memory
remediation.juniper:
delete snmp community public
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user snmpv3user authentication-sha
commit
remediation.palo_alto:
set deviceconfig system snmpv3 views all-mibs type included oid 1
commit
